name: Arctic Air Freedom Wearable Neck Fan & Air Purifier | USB Rechargeable 3-Speed Personal Cooler for Indoor Outdoor Travel
description:
Stay cool anywhere with the Arctic Air Freedom Wearable Neck Fan, a 3-speed personal cooler and air purifier in one. Powered by USB rechargeable battery and Comfort Chill™ technology, it provides refreshing airflow directly to your face and neck. The flexible, lightweight design fits comfortably around your neck for hands-free use indoors or outdoors—ideal for travel, gym, office, or relaxation. Random color will be shipped.
Key Features
 Wearable hands-free neck fan with purifier
 3 adjustable fan speeds with Comfort Chill™
 USB rechargeable for portable use
 Lightweight & flexible design for all-day comfort
 Cordless operation for indoor & outdoor use
 Random color included in package
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic body, rechargeable battery, electronic components
How to Use
 Place fan around your neck
 Press power button to turn on
 Adjust fan speed as desired
 Recharge using the included USB cable
Package Includes
 1 × Arctic Air Freedom Wearable Neck Fan (Random Color)
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
